properties.title: New Leadership at Tupolev Amid Ongoing Production Struggles
properties.summary: Yuri Abrosimov has been appointed as the new Acting Managing Director of Tupolev, marking yet another leadership change in a company that has seen seven directors in eleven years. This transition comes as Tupolev continues to grapple with significant production delays and operational challenges in its Tu-214 program, raising questions about the potential for meaningful improvements under new management.

properties.title: JSC Tupolev Negotiates 5.6 Billion Ruble Claim with Tatneft Amid Court Postponement
properties.summary: JSC Tupolev is currently in negotiations with Tatneft over a substantial claim of 5.6 billion rubles, with a new meeting set for March 5 to discuss the ongoing legal dispute. The Arbitration Court of Tatarstan has granted Tupolev a one-month postponement to address unresolved issues, indicating the complexity of the case and the potential for further developments in the coming weeks.

properties.title: Tupolev Seeks Delay in 5.6 Billion Ruble Legal Dispute with Tatneft
properties.summary: JSC Tupolev is embroiled in a legal dispute with Tatneft over a substantial claim of 5.6 billion rubles. The Arbitration Court of Tatarstan has set a hearing for March 5, but Tupolev has requested a postponement until May, which Tatneft has tentatively agreed to. Furthermore, Tupolev is seeking to have the case dismissed, citing concerns over the confidentiality of commercial secrets involved in the proceedings.

properties.title: Tatneft Files Lawsuit for 5.6 Billion Rubles Against Tupolev
properties.summary: Tatneft has initiated legal action against Tupolev JSC and the Gorbunov Kazan Aviation Plant, seeking the recovery of 5.6 billion rubles. This lawsuit, filed with the Arbitration Court of Tatarstan on November 1, 2024, is part of ongoing economic disputes stemming from previous contracts with the Gabon government. The case highlights the escalating financial tensions between the companies involved.
